details: Bitcoin (BTC) reached $66,400 on July 21, marking its first ascent above $66,000 since June 17. This rally is attributed to five consecutive days of net inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), accumulating approximately $727.3 million. The last single session saw inflows of $226.9 million. BTC further extended its consolidation uptrend towards $66,800 on July 22.
title: Bitcoin Price Surpasses $66K on $727M ETF Inflows Over 5 Days

details: Ethereum (ETH) exhibits strong bullish momentum, fueled by nearly $2 billion worth of ETH withdrawn from exchanges over the past month, significantly reducing sell-side supply. The cryptocurrency's staking ratio has reached an all-time high of 33.9%. Additionally, US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $37.47 million in net inflows in the latest session, boosting investor confidence and pushing ETH towards the $2,000 mark.
title: Ethereum Nears $2,000 on $2B Exchange Exodus, Record Staking, and ETF Inflows

details: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the CLARITY Act, a significant bill aiming to classify XRP and Bitcoin as digital commodities, is nearing Senate passage. This legislative progress was facilitated by President Trump's agreement to ethics provisions preventing federal officials from personally profiting from crypto. The news caused XRP to jump 3.5% to $1.1485.
title: CLARITY Act on "1-Yard Line," Boosts XRP Amidst Trump's Ethics Agreement

details: Pavel Durov, CEO of Telegram, revealed plans on July 21 for the imminent launch of a native non-custodial Gram Wallet. This development is expected to integrate self-custody and Web3 capabilities for Telegram's extensive user base of over 1 billion, representing a significant step for widespread crypto adoption. The native version is slated for release in summer 2026.
title: Telegram CEO Announces Native Self-Custody Gram Wallet for 1 Billion Users

details: The Financial Action Task Force (FATF) issued a cautionary statement, highlighting that many countries lack a clear understanding of decentralized finance (DeFi) activities within their jurisdictions and the associated money laundering risks. The FATF noted that DeFi's rapid execution, cross-border reach, and anonymity-enhancing features pose significant challenges for effective regulation.
title: FATF Warns Most Countries Unprepared for DeFi Money Laundering Risks

details: In recent DeFi news, Celsius co-founders have agreed to pay $6.5 million to settle fraud claims. Separately, the Wanchain Cardano bridge experienced an exploit, resulting in a loss of $9 million in NIGHT tokens. Conversely, the Robinhood Chain ecosystem is showing robust growth, with its developer activity noted as leading among various blockchain ecosystems.
title: DeFi Daily: Celsius Settlement, Wanchain Exploit, Robinhood Chain Growth

details: The Winklevoss twins made a $10 million contribution to Donald Trump's super PAC. This donation comes 23 days after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) joined Gemini's relief bid.
title: Winklevoss Twins Donate $10M to Trump PAC Amidst CFTC's Gemini Relief Bid
